purpose: Test the full-gain horizontal velocity and displacement-integral observation on additional sensor draws, interval gyro sampling and engine vibration using the current OU-III startup.

regimes.matched: After release, full horizontal S + beta v, horizontal variance ratio 5/8.
regimes.half: After release, horizontal S + 0.5 beta v, original horizontal variance.

comparison.engine: 8.5 m PM-Stokes and JONSWAP in both directions at 2400 RPM, 80 Hz bandwidth and 0.60 or 1.20 m/s² level.
